summary: CRT locale character-type / case-mapping table initializer. When GetCPInfo(dword_8D46BC, &CPInfo) succeeds, builds a 256-byte source string filled with its own indices, blanks out the code-page lead-byte gaps with space (0x20), then fills the CharType classification array via sub_595DC8 and two case-mapped strings via sub_591FA1 (offset 0x100 and 0x200); a final loop classifies each character into byte_8D47E1 (bits 0x10 / 0x20) and stores the mapped byte into byte_8D46E0. On GetCPInfo failure it falls back to a hardcoded ASCII-only pass that classifies 'A'-'Z' and 'a'-'z' and produces the case-swap mapping.

operations.description: Branch on GetCPInfo(dword_8D46BC, &CPInfo): non-zero takes the code-page path, zero takes the ASCII fallback path.
Fill SrcStr[i] = i for i in 0..0x100-1, then force SrcStr[0] = 0x20 (space).
For each lead-byte pair in CPInfo.LeadByte, memset the SrcStr range v1..v3 to 0x20 (space), walking until a zero lead byte.
sub_595DC8(1, SrcStr, 256, CharType, dword_8D46BC, dword_8D48E4, 0) fills the CharType classification array.
sub_591FA1(dword_8D48E4, 0x100, SrcStr, 256, DestStr, 256, dword_8D46BC, 0) fills the first case-mapped string DestStr.
sub_591FA1(dword_8D48E4, 0x200, SrcStr, 256, v9, 256, dword_8D46BC, 0) fills the second case-mapped string v9.

Walk CharType[0..255]: when (entry & 1) set class bit 0x10 in byte_8D47E1 and copy DestStr into byte_8D46E0; else when (entry & 2) set class bit 0x20 and copy v9 into byte_8D46E0; else store 0 into byte_8D46E0.

ASCII fallback pass for result in 0..0x100-1: 'A'-'Z' (0x41..0x5A) get class bit 0x10 and byte_8D46E0 = result + 0x20; 'a'-'z' (0x61..0x7A) get class bit 0x20 and byte_8D46E0 = result - 0x20; otherwise byte_8D46E0 = 0.
Return 0x100 on the code-page path (loop counter result after the classification walk), or result after the ASCII fallback loop.

clean_pseudocode: for (int i = 0; i < 0x100; i++) SrcStr[i] = i;
for (lead-byte pair ranges) memset(&SrcStr[v1], 0x20, v3 - v1 + 1);
else if (r >= 0x61 && r <= 0x7A) { byte_8D47E1[r] |= 0x20; byte_8D46E0[r] = r - 0x20; }
